help.1: * Type /commands in chat window to see a list of commands.
help.2: * Click the menu on the left side of the chat window, or press the Tab key to change the chat channel.
help.3: * You can configure the chat window to be displayed within or outside of the game screen using either the Settings/Option menu, or the button located on the right side of the chat window.
help.4: * The external chat box feature is only supported in windowed mode.
help.5: * You can right-click the chat window tab to set a filter.
help.6: * Use the Whisper button in the Chat window to select who you want to send a whisper to.
help.7: * Use the Link button in the Chat window to chat about your obtained items or earned achievements.
help.8: * In 'Chat Commands,' click the Chat Shortcut button to open the My Chat Shortcuts window.
help.9: * Use the Emoticon button in the Chat window to open the Emoticon window.
help.10: * Use Maple Chat to create a chat room, in which you can chat with up to 5 other players.

command.2: : Sends a message to players nearby.
command.4: : Selects a whisper partner. If a character name is specified, sends a whisper to that character.
command.6: : Sends a whisper to a recent partner.
command.8: : Sends a message to your party members.
command.14: : Display a list of your current parties and characters to invite to a party. If entered with a character name, invites that character to the party. (Party leader only.)
command.16: : Kicks the specified party member out of the party. (Party leader only.)
command.18: : Sends a message to your guild.
command.20: : Invites the specified character to your guild. (Guild masters only.)
command.22: : Sends a message to your Alliance.
command.26: : Select a group you'd like to chat with. If a group name is specified, sends a message to online members of that group.
command.28: : Enters Maple Chat. If a character name is specified, they will be invited to the Maple Chat. Up to 5 names can be entered.
command.32: : Emoticon input UI, displays emoticon favorites list
